summary: Upload the released technical drawing of this packaging unit — the dimensioned drawing your packaging supplier produces to, not a marketing image. The TD must contain it (Annex VII 2(b)), and the recyclability and minimisation assessments are judged against it.
上传该包装单元已发布的技术图纸——即包装供应商据以生产的带尺寸图纸，而非营销效果图。技术文档必须包含该图纸（Annex VII 2(b)），可回收性与最小化评估均以其为依据。
terms: Manufacturing drawing
制造图纸
A controlled drawing with dimensions, tolerances and materials from which the packaging is produced.
据以生产包装的受控图纸，含尺寸、公差和材料。
Conceptual design
概念设计
The design intent: the structure and how the packaging works (closing, opening, protection).
设计意图：包装结构及其工作方式（封口、开启、保护）。
Revision
版本
The release status of the drawing (e.g. R2). Every change creates a new revision.
图纸的发布状态（如 R2）。每次变更产生新版本。
logic: Annex VII 2(b) lists 'conceptual design, manufacturing drawings and materials of components' as TD content.
Annex VII 2(b) 将“概念设计、制造图纸及组件材料”列为技术文档内容。
The Commission FAQ (2026) confirms the manufacturer must have them in its TD — relying on the supplier keeping them is not enough.
委员会 FAQ（2026）确认制造商必须在其技术文档中具备这些图纸——仅依赖供应商保存不够。
The drawing fixes the assessed object: recyclability (Art 6) and minimisation (Art 10) conclusions are only valid for this revision.
图纸锁定被评估对象：可回收性（Art 6）与最小化（Art 10）结论仅对该版本有效。
Therefore a later change of revision triggers a re-assessment (Art 15(4)).
因此日后版本变更将触发重新评估（Art 15(4)）。
info: Drawing number and revision, exactly as in the title block.
图号与版本，与图框完全一致。
Outer dimensions L × W × H in mm, wall / board thickness, tolerances.
外形尺寸 长 × 宽 × 高（mm）、壁厚 / 板厚、公差。
Every component shown or listed with its material (matches the BOM).
每个组件均在图中显示或列出并注明材料（与 BOM 一致）。
Closures, inserts, windows, handles, labels — all parts that belong to the unit.
封口、内衬、开窗、提手、标签——属于该单元的全部部件。
minimum: Released drawing file (PDF / DWG / DXF) uploaded
已上传发布版图纸文件（PDF / DWG / DXF）
Materials in the drawing match the BOM components
图纸中的材料与 BOM 组件一致
recommended: Same revision as the artwork (C03-12) and the die-cut (C03-11)
与 Artwork（C03-12）及刀模图（C03-11）版本一致
Revision history table on the drawing
图纸上附修订记录表
Name the file with its evidence ID, e.g. PU-001-DRW-001_DW-2026-010_R2.pdf
以证据编号命名文件，如 PU-001-DRW-001_DW-2026-010_R2.pdf
steps: Ask your packaging supplier or design department for the current released drawing (not a draft).
向包装供应商或设计部门索取当前已发布的图纸（非草稿）。
Check the title block: drawing number, revision, date and approver are visible.
检查图框：图号、版本、日期、批准人清晰可见。
Check that dimensions (mm) and materials are shown for every component in the BOM.
检查 BOM 中每个组件的尺寸（mm）和材料均已标注。
Type the drawing number and revision into the field below, e.g. DW-2026-010 R2.
在下方字段填写图号与版本，如 DW-2026-010 R2。
Upload the PDF (or DWG/DXF) as evidence type DRW and run 'Check my entry'.
以证据类型 DRW 上传 PDF（或 DWG/DXF），然后点击“检查我的填写”。
good: DW-2026-010 R2, dated 2026-06-15: folding carton 210 × 148 × 40 mm, GC2 board 350 g/m², window film none, glue line marked — matches BOM PU-001-C001.
bad: A 3D render from marketing without dimensions or revision.
营销部门提供的 3D 效果图，无尺寸、无版本。
A drawing marked 'DRAFT' or with a revision different from the artwork.
标注“草稿”或版本与 Artwork 不一致的图纸。

help: Drawing number + revision, as printed in the title block.
图号 + 版本，与图框一致。

summary: For cartons, boxes, sleeves and trays made from a flat blank: upload the die-cut (cutting / creasing) drawing that shows how the blank is cut and folded.
对于由平面坯料制成的纸盒、纸箱、套管和托盘：上传刀模（模切 / 压痕）图，展示坯料如何裁切和折叠。
terms: Die-cut drawing
刀模图
Flat layout of the blank with cut lines, crease lines and glue areas.
坯料的平面展开图，含裁切线、压痕线和粘合区域。
logic: Annex VII 2(b) manufacturing drawings include the structural drawing where the packaging is formed from a blank.
当包装由坯料成型时，Annex VII 2(b) 的制造图纸包含结构展开图。
The blank size and glue areas drive material use (Art 10) and adhesive compatibility (Art 6(9)).
坯料尺寸与粘合区域决定材料用量（Art 10）及胶黏剂相容性（Art 6(9)）。
info: Drawing number / revision; blank size; cut, crease and glue lines; board grade and flute.
图号 / 版本；坯料尺寸；裁切、压痕与粘合线；纸板等级与楞型。
minimum: Die-cut drawing uploaded (or N/A requested for packaging not made from a blank)
已上传刀模图（非坯料成型的包装可申请 N/A）
recommended: Same revision as C03-10
与 C03-10 版本一致
steps: Ask the converter for the CAD die-line file of the current revision.
向加工商索取当前版本的 CAD 刀模线文件。
Enter its number and revision, upload as DRW.
填写编号与版本，以 DRW 类型上传。
Not made from a blank (bottle, pouch, film)? Use 'Not applicable' and say why.
非坯料成型（瓶、袋、膜）？请使用“不适用”并说明理由。
good: DC-2026-010 R2: blank 420 × 310 mm, E-flute, crease and glue lines marked.
DC-2026-010 R2：坯料 420 × 310 mm，E 楞，标注压痕线与糊口。
bad: Photo of the opened box instead of the die-line.
用打开的纸盒照片代替刀模线。

summary: Upload the final approved artwork (print file) for this unit. It shows what is printed on the packaging — including the manufacturer's name and postal address and the batch/type identification required since 12 Aug 2026.
上传该单元最终批准的 Artwork（印刷文件）。它展示包装上印刷的内容——包括自 2026-08-12 起要求的制造商名称、邮寄地址及批号/型号识别。
terms: Artwork
Artwork（印刷稿）
The approved print file with all texts, symbols and colours.
包含全部文字、符号和颜色的已批准印刷文件。
logic: Art 15(5)-(6) require identification and manufacturer contact details on the packaging from 12 Aug 2026.
Art 15(5)-(6) 要求自 2026-08-12 起包装上须有识别信息及制造商联系信息。
Art 12 labels follow from 12 Aug 2028 (or later); the artwork is where they will appear.
Art 12 标签自 2028-08-12（或更晚）起适用；它们将出现在 Artwork 上。
Art 12(8): no misleading sustainability claims or symbols.
Art 12(8)：不得有误导性的可持续性声明或标识。
info: Artwork number / revision; all panels; position of manufacturer info and batch code.
Artwork 编号 / 版本；全部版面；制造商信息与批号的位置。
minimum: 已上传最终 Artwork 文件
已填写 Artwork 编号与版本
recommended: Mark the manufacturer info and batch code areas on a copy
在副本上标出制造商信息与批号区域
Check environmental claims against Art 12(8) before release
发布前对照 Art 12(8) 核查环保声明
steps: Export the approved artwork as PDF (all panels).
将批准的 Artwork 导出为 PDF（全部版面）。
Enter its number and revision.
填写编号与版本。
Upload as PHO or DRW; then complete C11-40 / C11-41 with the positions.
以 PHO 或 DRW 类型上传；随后在 C11-40 / C11-41 中填写位置。
good: AW-2026-010 R3 (PDF, 4 panels): manufacturer name + postal address on back panel, lot code on bottom flap.
AW-2026-010 R3（PDF，4 个版面）：背面印制造商名称 + 邮寄地址，底部折边印批号。
bad: Low-resolution JPG where small print cannot be read.
低分辨率 JPG，小字无法辨认。

summary: Upload the manufacturing specification: the controlled document that fixes how the packaging is produced (materials, grammage/thickness, tolerances, process conditions).
上传制造规格书：规定包装如何生产的受控文件（材料、克重/厚度、公差、工艺条件）。
terms: Manufacturing specification
制造规格书
Document defining the product characteristics production must achieve, with tolerances.
规定生产须达到的产品特性及公差的文件。
logic: Annex VII point 3 and Art 15(4): production must stay in conformity with the TD.
Annex VII 第 3 点与 Art 15(4)：生产须持续符合技术文档。
The specification turns TD conclusions into production limits (e.g. maximum mass).
规格书将技术文档结论转化为生产限值（如最大质量）。
info: Spec number / revision; key characteristics with nominal values and tolerances; link to the drawing revision.
规格书编号 / 版本；关键特性的标称值及公差；关联的图纸版本。
minimum: 已填写规格书编号与版本
recommended: Include unit mass with tolerance — needed for Art 10 and the BOM check
包含单元质量及公差——Art 10 与 BOM 核对需要
steps: Obtain the current production specification from the supplier or your QA.
向供应商或 QA 获取当前生产规格书。
Check it references the same drawing revision as C03-10.
检查其引用的图纸版本与 C03-10 一致。
Enter number/revision and upload.
填写编号/版本并上传。
good: SPEC-PU001 Rev 4: GC2 350 g/m² ± 3 %, mass 14 g ± 0.5 g, refers to DW-2026-010 R2.
SPEC-PU001 Rev 4：GC2 350 g/m² ± 3%，质量 14 g ± 0.5 g，引用 DW-2026-010 R2。

summary: Upload the process / control plan: which characteristics are checked in production, how often, with what method, and what happens if out of tolerance.
上传工艺 / 控制计划：生产中检查哪些特性、频次、方法，以及超差时如何处理。
terms: Control plan
控制计划
Table of process steps, controlled characteristics, methods, frequency and reaction plan.
列出工序、受控特性、方法、频次与反应计划的表格。
logic: Annex VII point 3 requires measures so that manufacturing and its monitoring ensure compliance.
Annex VII 第 3 点要求采取措施，使制造及其监控确保符合性。
The plan shows the PPWR-relevant characteristics (mass, material, inks) are controlled.
计划表明与 PPWR 相关的特性（质量、材料、油墨）受控。
info: Plan number / revision; PPWR-relevant characteristics (mass, board grade, ink system) with frequency and reaction plan.
计划编号 / 版本；与 PPWR 相关的特性（质量、纸板等级、油墨体系）及频次与反应计划。
minimum: 已填写计划编号与版本
recommended: Link incoming inspection (C13-51) and release (C13-53) records to this plan
将来料检验（C13-51）与放行（C13-53）记录关联至本计划
steps: Get the current control plan from the producing site.
向生产工厂获取当前控制计划。
Check that mass and material identity are controlled characteristics.
检查质量和材料身份是否为受控特性。
Enter number/revision and upload.
填写编号/版本并上传。
good: CP-PU001 R1: board grammage per reel (IQC), carton mass 5 pcs/shift, ink supplier lot recorded.
CP-PU001 R1：每卷纸检验克重（IQC），每班抽 5 个称重，记录油墨批号。
bad: A flowchart without characteristics or frequencies.
只有流程图，没有特性和频次。

help: 控制计划编号 + 版本。

summary: Explain in plain words why the packaging is designed this way: what it must protect, how it is filled, transported and used, and why it cannot be lighter or smaller. This text becomes the design explanation of the TD.
用通俗语言说明包装为何这样设计：须保护什么、如何灌装、运输和使用，以及为何无法更轻或更小。该文字将成为技术文档中的设计说明。
terms: Design rationale
设计理由
The reasons behind the structure, material and size choices.
选择结构、材料和尺寸的理由。
Annex IV criteria
Annex IV 准则
Eight criteria (protection, manufacturing, logistics, functionality, information, hygiene & safety, legal, recycled content / recyclability / re-use) that can justify weight and volume.
可用于证明重量与体积合理性的八项准则（保护、制造、物流、功能、信息、卫生与安全、法律、再生含量/可回收/重复使用）。
logic: Annex VII 2(c) requires the explanations needed to understand the drawings and how the packaging works.
Annex VII 2(c) 要求提供理解图纸及包装工作方式所需的说明。
From 1 Jan 2030, Art 10(4)(b) requires, per Annex IV criterion, the design requirement that prevents further reduction.
自 2030-01-01 起，Art 10(4)(b) 要求针对每项 Annex IV 准则说明阻止进一步减量的设计要求。
Writing it now per criterion avoids rework later.
现在就按准则撰写可避免日后返工。
info: One short paragraph per relevant Annex IV criterion, citing tests or data where available (evidence IDs).
每项相关 Annex IV 准则一段简短说明，尽可能引用测试或数据（证据编号）。
minimum: 已填写设计理由（≥ 100 字符）
At least protection, manufacturing and logistics addressed
至少涉及保护、制造与物流
recommended: Cite evidence IDs of drop/compression tests (C09-30)
引用跌落/压缩测试的证据编号（C09-30）
Mention options you investigated and why they were rejected
说明曾研究的方案及放弃原因
steps: Write 2-3 sentences: what the product is and what can damage it.
写 2-3 句：产品是什么，什么会损坏它。
Add a sentence each on filling/manufacturing, transport/stacking and opening/use.
分别就灌装/制造、运输/堆码和开启/使用各写一句。
State why the current material and size are the minimum (e.g. thinner board failed the compression test).
说明为何当前材料与尺寸已是最低（如更薄纸板未通过压缩测试）。
Cite evidence IDs; save and run 'Check my entry'.
引用证据编号；保存并点击“检查我的填写”。
good: Protection: 350 g/m² board is needed to protect the printed card from bending (bending test PU-001-TST-003). Manufacturing: format fits the existing folder-gluer. Logistics: 48 cartons per case pass stacking test. Information: back panel carries required manufacturer data.
保护：需 350 g/m² 纸板以防印刷卡片弯折（弯曲测试 PU-001-TST-003）。制造：尺寸适配现有糊盒机。物流：每箱 48 盒通过堆码测试。信息：背面承载法定制造商信息。

help: One sentence per Annex IV criterion that drives the design.
每项驱动设计的 Annex IV 准则写一句。
